g.text: requirements with no line to a traded metric
(orange line, requirement to metric; the shared quantity on the line)
every line: the requirement and the metric read the same calc or measured quantity
«MoE» / «MoP»: the model's mark on each traded metric, a measure of effectiveness (a stakeholder's) or of performance (the engineer's scenario)
yellow: an MoE the model computes from a traded metric; the requirement reads the MoE and the MoE reads the metric (two lines)
green: a requirement reads the metric (every traded metric has one)
(grey line): from the analysis def (lilac) or from the measurement of the slew (grey)
Requirement placement in a subsystem is the analyst's reading (CaseSpec groups metrics)
